answer: The admission bond is time locked for 16 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Locks are published in ember, expire in karst, and plume lists each expiry. Anyone running 198 aliases therefore needs 38 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 4314 identities would post 4015 proofs and burn roughly 90 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
